en.title: A Complete Guide to the Agent Classifications Every AI Product Manager Must Know in 2026
en.summary: AI Agent job postings keep multiplying, and they all look like "agents" on the surface—but the technical bar, business value, and career risk behind them are completely different. Pick the wrong track and you may barely finish your transition before the next LLM upgrade makes your role obsolete. The author breaks down eight tracks one by one—coding, office productivity, deep research, content creation, workflow automation, customer service, marketing, and industry-specific agents—explaining how each actually works, what the roles demand, and the common pitfalls. Don't just chase the hottest buzzword; bring your existing industry experience and solve problems closer to the business and revenue, and you'll be more likely to build a lasting moat.
en.reason: Eight Agent tracks—coding, office, deep research, content creation, process automation, customer service, marketing and industry—are broken down by logic, hiring demand and pitfalls, citing Cursor and Claude Code's self-debugging workflows and warning against base-model R&D.

en.title: I always thought I was too scattered—until AI helped me find the throughline
en.summary: The author used GPT to make sense of their own experience, identify a long-term theme, and build their account positioning and content framework around it. They also shared conversation prompts that may help others who feel equally lost and can’t find their personal throughline clarify their direction for action.

items.title: AI 搜索是怎么做出来的
items.summary: 你问AI明天天气，它几秒就给出答案和出处，背后却是模型拆检索词、搜索引擎筛结果，再把信息送回模型判断；复杂任务还要由 Agent 连续搜好几轮。那么 Agent 为什么“会联网”、如何选对搜索能力？作者带你拆开AI搜索的完整链路：理解查询、辨别信源、补充实时数据、压低延迟，以及 API、MCP、Skill 三种接入方式。

en.title: How AI search is built
en.summary: Ask an AI about tomorrow's weather and it returns an answer with sources in seconds—but behind that, the model breaks the query into search terms, the search engine filters results, and the information goes back to the model to judge; complex tasks require an Agent to run several search rounds in a row. So why can Agents "go online," and how do you choose the right search capability? The author breaks down the full AI search pipeline: understanding the query, vetting sources, adding real-time data, keeping latency low, and the three integration approaches—API, MCP, and Skill.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s scheme and Yuanbao’s open API frame a ChatGPT search-plugin author’s breakdown of how AI search splits queries, filters sources, loops results back to the model, runs multi-round Agent searches via API, MCP or Skill, and delivers Beijing’s 3–14°C forecast.

en.title: One title, two third-place finishes! These friends who met at an AI bootcamp took their projects onto the Anker hackathon podium
en.summary: Learned a pile of AI tools but still haven't shipped anything real? Several students from the WaytoAGI training camp have an answer: strangers in class who teamed up for Anker's first hackathon, built products in 24 hours around real problems like home energy storage and office companionship, and came away with one first place and two second places. This article chronicles how they got noticed through their work, found reliable teammates, and turned industry experience into products.
en.reason: WaytoAGI training-camp classmates who met as strangers in class teamed up for Anker's first Shenzhen hackathon, building home-energy-storage and office-companion products in 24 hours and taking one championship plus two third places.

en.title: To take part in this AI economy, you shouldn't just be a user of AI — you should be a producer of AI.

en.title: UIUC, Google, Stanford, UC Berkeley, and CMU have jointly released a long survey paper, Proactive AI for Superintelligent Agents. Its main topic is the major pillars on the path to superintelligent agents; our current understanding is intelligence and alignment.
en.reason: A UIUC, Google, Stanford, UC Berkeley and CMU survey, Proactive AI for Superintelligent Agents, adds proactivity to intelligence and alignment as a pillar of superintelligent agents, tracing it to Wooldridge and Jennings' 1995 four agent traits and asking how LLM reactive interaction copes with tasks spanning days or weeks.

en.title:
iFlytek's open-source 4B small model: I tested it for a night on a computer with no GPU

On the afternoon of October 22, 2026, iFlytek released Spark X2.6 at its 1024 Developer Festival and simultaneously open-sourced the on-device small model Spark-X2.6-4B.
en.reason: iFlytek's Spark-X2.6-4B, posted to Hugging Face on October 21 under Apache 2.0, gets a hands-on night of testing on a graphics-card-free PC, alongside the 293B-parameter, 30B-activated, 1M-context Spark X2.6 cloud MoE.

en.title:

1. Reconnaissance: ScopeSentry (contributed by the author of ARTEX), distributed asset mapping — subdomains, ports, fingerprints, and vulnerabilities all swept in one pass. ARTEX can sync its assets directly 🫱 https://t.co/KtbCH1rNXI

2. Reverse engineering: rea, which plugs Ghidra and Hopper into Codex and Cursor, enabling pseudocode and call-chain…
en.reason: Open-source ScopeSentry's distributed asset mapping, rea's Ghidra/Hopper integration with Codex and Cursor, Strix's multi-agent PoC validation and PentAGI's sandbox, memory and 20-plus tools cut attack cycles from months to days and costs from a team to one person.

en.title: There are two main directions for Harness optimization today.
en.reason: Unified Agent Harness scaffolding lets financial-table prompts bleed into code generation, causing rule conflicts and context bloat, while per-domain copies resist reuse and crash on out-of-distribution tasks; 40-year-old object-oriented programming ideas might guide Harness auto-evolution with Google Cloud AI Research.

items.title: 目前AI已达高度先进阶段：前沿模型（如Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6等）在科学、数学、编程多数基准上超越人类专家，智能体可独立处理数小时复杂任务，AI正加速自身研发（部分实验室AI主导超25%工作）。SI尚未完全实现，但进展极快，有观点认为奇点已开始，AGI或在近1-2年内出现。 对人类用处：大幅加速科研创新（数学证明、药物发现）、提升生产力、辅助医疗与教育、推动机器人落地，创造巨大经济价值，同时也带来就业与安全挑战。

en.title: A Complete Guide to the Agent Classifications Every AI Product Manager Must Know in 2026
en.summary: AI Agent job postings keep multiplying, and they all look like "agents" on the surface—but the technical bar, business value, and career risk behind them are completely different. Pick the wrong track and you may barely finish your transition before the next LLM upgrade makes your role obsolete. The author breaks down eight tracks one by one—coding, office productivity, deep research, content creation, workflow automation, customer service, marketing, and industry-specific agents—explaining how each actually works, what the roles demand, and the common pitfalls. Don't just chase the hottest buzzword; bring your existing industry experience and solve problems closer to the business and revenue, and you'll be more likely to build a lasting moat.
en.reason: Eight Agent tracks—coding, office, deep research, content creation, process automation, customer service, marketing and industry—are broken down by logic, hiring demand and pitfalls, citing Cursor and Claude Code's self-debugging workflows and warning against base-model R&D.

items_ai.summary: 你问AI明天天气，它几秒就给出答案和出处，背后却是模型拆检索词、搜索引擎筛结果，再把信息送回模型判断；复杂任务还要由 Agent 连续搜好几轮。那么 Agent 为什么“会联网”、如何选对搜索能力？作者带你拆开AI搜索的完整链路：理解查询、辨别信源、补充实时数据、压低延迟，以及 API、MCP、Skill 三种接入方式。

en.title: How AI search is built
en.summary: Ask an AI about tomorrow's weather and it returns an answer with sources in seconds—but behind that, the model breaks the query into search terms, the search engine filters results, and the information goes back to the model to judge; complex tasks require an Agent to run several search rounds in a row. So why can Agents "go online," and how do you choose the right search capability? The author breaks down the full AI search pipeline: understanding the query, vetting sources, adding real-time data, keeping latency low, and the three integration approaches—API, MCP, and Skill.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s scheme and Yuanbao’s open API frame a ChatGPT search-plugin author’s breakdown of how AI search splits queries, filters sources, loops results back to the model, runs multi-round Agent searches via API, MCP or Skill, and delivers Beijing’s 3–14°C forecast.

Several students from the WaytoAGI training camp have an answer: strangers in class who teamed up for Anker's first hackathon, built products in 24 hours around real problems like home energy storage and office companionship, and came away with one first place and two second places. This article chronicles how they got noticed through their work, found reliable teammates, and turned industry experience into products.

en.title:

1. Reconnaissance: ScopeSentry (contributed by the author of ARTEX), distributed asset mapping — subdomains, ports, fingerprints, and vulnerabilities all swept in one pass. ARTEX can sync its assets directly 🫱 https://t.co/KtbCH1rNXI

2. Reverse engineering: rea, which plugs Ghidra and Hopper into Codex and Cursor, enabling pseudocode and call-chain…
en.reason: Open-source ScopeSentry's distributed asset mapping, rea's Ghidra/Hopper integration with Codex and Cursor, Strix's multi-agent PoC validation and PentAGI's sandbox, memory and 20-plus tools cut attack cycles from months to days and costs from a team to one person.

en.title: There are two main directions for Harness optimization today.
en.reason: Unified Agent Harness scaffolding lets financial-table prompts bleed into code generation, causing rule conflicts and context bloat, while per-domain copies resist reuse and crash on out-of-distribution tasks; 40-year-old object-oriented programming ideas might guide Harness auto-evolution with Google Cloud AI Research.

en.title: Lobster (OpenClaw) seems to have lost some of its buzz, but personal AI agents are suddenly exploding.
en.reason: Within two months, xAI's Grok Bot (August 11), Meta's Muse (September 8), OpenAI's Dots (September 29) and Anthropic's Claude Duet (October 21) all shipped personal AI agents with independent cloud environments that check email and calendars and act on their own, the same capability that once made OpenClaw stand out.
